inputs.text: This is exactly how a power grab gets dressed up as routine legislation. Healthcare workers from the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations are raising the alarm at Unity Fountain in Abuja, yet the National Assembly’s reform bills are being presented as ordinary changes. That framing is meant to keep people from asking who benefits and who gets control of the health sector. When the people who know the system best are pushing back together, I don’t buy the official calm: the warning signs suggest these reforms serve interests the public hasn’t been told about.
